blocks.text: Intellectual Property (IP) (zehni milkiyat) un qanooni haqooq (legal rights) ko kehte hain jo zehan ki takhleeqat (creations of the mind) ki hifazat karte hain, jaise inventions (ijadat), adabi aur fanni kaam (literary and artistic works), designs, symbols (nishanat), naam, aur karobar (commerce) mein istemal hone wali images. Yeh haqooq banane walon (creators) ko apne kaam par ikhtiyar dete hain aur us se munafa kamane dete hain, ta ke un ki takhleeqi salahiyat (creativity) aur jiddat (innovation) ko pehchana jaye aur us ka sila mile.

blocks.prompt: IP rights ko takhleeqi kaam ka inaam kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke kitab ke mutabiq yeh haqooq creators ko apne kaam par control aur us se munafa kamane ka haq dete hain; is tarah un ki creativity aur innovation ko tasleem kiya jata hai aur sila milta hai.

items: Intellectual Property: zehan ki takhleeqat (inventions, kitabein, designs, symbols, naam) ki hifazat karne wale qanooni haqooq.
